hook: The guided Audio workflow in IncuBrix: what it actually does and when to use it.
caption:
Source-specific lens: But here's where I'd push back on anyone who thinks AI solves everything: it doesn't.

If you create audio content — podcasts, voiceovers, narrations — the guided Audio workflow in IncuBrix takes you from idea to generated voiceover in one place.

The sequence:
1. Enter your topic or existing script
2. AI generates a draft script you can refine inline
3. Choose your tone/style (the tool offers style adaptation)
4. AI recommends voices and you choose from multiple options
5. Adjust pause and stability controls
6. Generate and review the voiceover

Voice cloning is also available as an option — which lets you use your own voice as the base.

This is the kind of workflow that reduces the gap between 'idea' and 'ready-to-publish' without requiring you to switch between five different tools.
